using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class Profile {Video, ImageBatch}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(Profile value)
inline std::optional<Profile> parse_profile(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(Profile value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(Profile value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, Profile value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, Profile value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kProfileNames
enum class Mode {Generate, Edit}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(Mode value)
inline std::optional<Mode> parse_mode(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(Mode value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(Mode value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, Mode value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, Mode value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kModeNames
inline const std::vector<std::string> kRequestGuaranteeNames
inline constexpr std::string_view kRequestGuaranteeLocalOnly
inline constexpr std::string_view kRequestGuaranteeHostedAllowed
inline const std::vector<std::string> kKinds
inline const std::vector<std::string> kExecutionGuarantees
struct ImageRequest
  std::string model
  Mode mode
  std::string prompt
  std::string size
  std::int64_t count
  std::string image_digest
  std::string image_media_type
  std::string mask_digest
  std::string mask_media_type
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  std::string credential
  std::vector<std::string> required_extensions
  std::map<std::string, std::string> extensions
struct Delivery
  std::string digest
  std::string media_type
  std::int64_t size
  std::string location
struct Request
  Profile profile
  ImageRequest image
  std::int64_t duration_ms
struct JobResult
  Profile profile
  std::vector<Delivery> deliveries
  std::string host
  std::string model
struct Document
  std::optional<Request> request
  std::optional<JobResult> result
inline std::string encode(const Document& v)
inline Document decode(std::string_view data)
